listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild — Switch edition (SavageWindRecomp)
listing.summary: SavageWindRecomp builds the Switch edition of Breath of the Wild on Windows or Linux from your own extracted 1.9.0 game. The project reports shrines and the Great Plateau. Later progress, controllers and gyro remain unconfirmed. DLC is unsupported.
listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Prepare the 1.9.0 ExeFS with main, main.npdm, rtld, sdk and subsdk0, plus the complete merged RomFS. The launcher does not decrypt a game file or supply keys, firmware or extraction tools.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use the Alpha 3 ZIP or AppImage launcher on Windows or Linux x64 with SSE4.2 and Vulkan 1.3. The launcher builds from your files locally. AVX2 and FMA can improve speed.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The Linux aarch64 build has not been tested on ARM hardware. Distant-map rendering remains incomplete. The project does not support version 1.8.2.

source_editions.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (Nintendo Switch)
